name: posterly
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：posterly。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Build an academic conference poster (ICML/NeurIPS/ICLR/CVPR/etc.) as a single HTML/CSS file and render it to print-ready PDF via headless Chromium. Use when user says \"做海报\", \"poster\", \"ICML/NeurIPS/ICLR poster\", or asks to design/edit a research poster.
